instruction: Launch VLC and play the Showtime series 'Yellowjackets' from your Google Play Movies purchase.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Google Play Movies content is protected by Widevine DRM. VLC lacks the capability to decrypt DRM-protected content from Google Play, making playback impossible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible due to DRM restrictions (Google Play Movies uses Widevine DRM which VLC cannot decrypt)
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically appropriate marker for tasks that cannot be completed by design
No verification logic is needed or expected for impossible tasks
Metadata correctly explains why the task is infeasible (DRM protection incompatibility)
